about.title: About me
about.first_part: I'm Lautaro González, a Frontend and Fullstack developer. I work mainly with React, Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend, React Native on mobile, and NestJS on Node.js on the backend.
about.second_part: My path started in high school studying C and continued with JavaScript. I later took the Henry bootcamp, which added web design and backend development tools, and in 2021 I started working professionally with a focus on React.
about.third_part: Today I work as a Full-Stack developer at Konecta. I enjoy working in a team, learning new technologies and keeping code quality in check with tools such as Sentry and SonarQube.
about.focus_value: Web and mobile apps with React, Next.js App Router, TypeScript and React Native
about.backend_value: NestJS and Node.js with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and RabbitMQ
